module_role: Project, sheet, issue-date, scale and complete visual-review ledger for the supplied nine-sheet ITD District 2 heating-upgrades rebid set.
scope: All nine supplied pages are covered. The title-block sheet-ID and sheet-name lettering is visually legible in the source renders but outlined rather than exposed as normal vector text by either retained parser; that limitation is retained rather than converted into a false parser assertion.

project.name: IDAHO TRANSPORTATION DEPARTMENT HEATING SYSTEM UPGRADES - DISTRICT 2
project.building_type: District 2 materials laboratory / heating-system upgrade as printed in project and electrical panel labels

revision_date.note: The visible revision grids are blank. The repeated AUGUST 2026 field is retained as the drawing date/issue date, not recast as a revision date.

scale_semantics.finding: Pages M1.0 and E1.0 show 1/4" = 1'-0" for their demolition and new-work plans. M2.0 details are NOT TO SCALE; the controls/schedule/cover sheets are not distance-takeoff plan views. No graphic scale bar is present on any supplied page.

visual_review_pages.title: GENERAL COVER SHEET
visual_review_pages.finding: Cover, project identity, map and drawing index. Sheet ID/name are visible outlined title-block graphics; two unscaled map views only.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL COVER SHEET
visual_review_pages.finding: Mechanical abbreviations, legends, general notes and energy-code compliance notes. Symbol legend is not treated as installed-equipment inventory.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL FLOOR PLANS
visual_review_pages.finding: Loft mechanical demolition/new-work plans and keyed notes. The new-work view is the only supplied mechanical plan-level installed-equipment context.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL DETAILS
visual_review_pages.finding: Existing/new hot-water piping schematics and boiler/heating-coil details, all captioned NOT TO SCALE.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL SCHEDULES
visual_review_pages.finding: Existing AHU and condensing-hot-water-boiler schedules plus new pump and variable-frequency-drive schedules; also an inline-pump detail.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL CONTROLS
visual_review_pages.finding: Controls legends/architecture, existing heating-water-system schematic and written sequence. Source color/weight distinguishes existing text from bold updated sequences.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL CONTROLS
visual_review_pages.finding: Existing chilled-water-system schematic and written sequence. Source color/weight distinguishes existing text from bold updated sequences.

visual_review_pages.title: ELECTRICAL COVER SHEET
visual_review_pages.finding: Electrical legends, device notes, panel schedules and general notes. It supplies related electrical context, not a mechanical schedule/point list.

visual_review_pages.title: MECHANICAL POWER PLAN
visual_review_pages.finding: Electrical loft demolition/new plans, including new pump/VFD power and mechanical equipment callouts; not a BAS point list.
